info.title: dydt Realtime Market Data
info.description: One multiplexed JSON WebSocket. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on connect, or send {"type":"auth","key":"<key>"} as the first frame (within 5 s). Then send subscribe/unsubscribe frames naming a stream and {"type":"ping"} every 15 s. Every event is {"stream": "<name>", "data": {…}}; streams that carry more than one kind of event put it in data.event. Close codes: 4401 invalid key, 4402 paid plan required (Free is REST only), 4429 connection limit or monthly message allowance used. Every data message counts toward the monthly allowance. Events are not replayed after a disconnect.

event_rankings.name: event_rankings
event_rankings.title: Event: Rankings
event_rankings.description: A snapshot of the current feed arrives right after you subscribe; each later snapshot replaces the whole feed. New snapshots follow each recompute that changes the feed: every minute for 5m, every 2 minutes for 1h, every 5 minutes for 6h and every 10 minutes for 24h. Live feeds (new_pair, migrated, almost_bonded) also send enter and exit as pools join or leave, and some send window batches with insert and remove ops. Snapshot values are as of the recompute. For tick-by-tick price, market cap and volume on the rows you show, also subscribe to pool_metrics with their pool addresses.
